title: Flow Graph Navbar Toggle Theming
description: Flow nodes/handles/edges must match navbar toggle theming: element gray default, hover fill + emphasized content, selected primary fill + emphasized stroke/text.
summary: Slider range, thumb, and value readout no longer use foreground/accent at rest: element-gray range (bg-element), panel thumb with border-element, hover-interactive-fill + emphasized border on hover, active-base fill when dragging/focused. Engagement control labels use text-element. Added slider chrome class exports and vitest.
